notes.title: (Hotfix) Update 9 — AMD Workarounds and UI Overhaul
notes.content:
This update focuses on resolving issues introduced by recent AMD drivers. I don’t have direct control over these problems -- or direct access to AMD hardware -- but I’ve implemented workarounds where possible. Doing so required a significant UI rework.

Getting the game running smoothly on AMD hardware has taken priority over new content and consumed a full week of development time. Content development had already begun before these issues appeared and is still moving forward, though at a slower pace due to the urgency of these fixes. Hopefully, things will stabilize soon and there will be fewer fires to put out going forward.

[b]Game Launcher[/b]
[list]
[*] You can configure display mode and render style before the game fully launches
[/list]

[b]UI Overhaul[/b]
[list]
[*] Changing a setting now opens up an option selection page. This allows for an overall description of what the setting does, and descriptions for each option. Overall this is a much more robust UI system that I plan to use going forward
[/list]

[b]Official Linux Support[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now officially play Saloonery on the coolest operating systems around
[/list]

[b]Misc. Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] The game is about 30% smaller and launches faster than before
[*] OpenGL rendering is no longer overwhelmingly bright. The visuals aren't as good as the other renderers, but it is now playable with that setting
[*] Game defaults to DirectX12 rendering on Windows computers with AMD graphics cards
[/list]

notes.title: (Hotfix) Update 8 — Alternate Rendering Options
notes.content:
This update adds the option to switch to a different rendering mode for players who encounter issues with the default Vulkan renderer. It also includes a range of bug fixes and general improvements made along the way.

[b]️ Settings Menu Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the option to switch between Vulkan, Directx12, and OpenGL rendering pipelines
[*] Renamed "Mouse" section of the settings menu to "Aiming" to make it mouse/gamepad agnostic
[/list]

[b]Misc. Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where bosses wouldn't attack the player immediately on noticing them
[*] Fixed bug where it was hard for cult melee enemies to hit the player
[*] Fixed damage numbers not appearing. I broke that in a previous update without noticing...
[*] Added additional invisible walls to make it harder to break the maps
[/list]

[b]️ Balance Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] A rapidly diminishing slowdown has been added to player movement after shooting. This helps differentiate weapon feel and makes shooting more impactful overall. To balance this effect, the base movement speed of some weapons has been increased
[*] Reloading from empty with certain weapons now takes longer initially but loads twice as much ammo. This change prevents the awkward scenario where players with high-capacity weapons run out of ammo and are forced into a frustrating loop of firing a single shot, reloading a single round, and repeating
[*] Buffed Hellfire Shotgun slightly
[/list]

[b]Gamepad Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where ADS while out of ammo on a gamepad would rapidly switch between aimed and not aiming states
[*] Added the ability to swap between weapons with the D-pad on gamepads
[*] Made gamepads affected by sensitivity setting. It's about time
[/list]

notes.title: Update 7 — Continued Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
I’ve been working on new content that will be coming in a future update, but in the meantime I’ve also put together a whole batch of bug fixes and improvements. Previously, the game wasn’t quite robust enough to handle the kinds of missions I’m working on adding, but these bug fixes and improvements allow it to support larger maps and more complex mission types without issue.

[b]Player Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved player ground collision to smoothly step over small ledges and gaps
[*] Fixed bug where player would stay in bullet time when dying
[*] Fixed bug which caused ammo UI to go off the screen
[*] Reduced FOV zoom-in when hitting an enemy to make it less visually jarring
[*] Fixed bug where you could aim when the game was paused
[*] Fixed bug where the health regained on kill from the Ol' Revolver would be multiplied when killing enemies with a shotgun
[*] Increased the fall speed when in bullet time so the player doesn't hover quite as much
[*] Lowered the stow height of weapons so they more completely disappear when swapping between them
[/list]

[b]Performance Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved environment LOD system for less pop-in
[*] Improved item LOD system for better performance
[*] Improve data saving and loading slightly to improve performance
[*] Optimized bullet trails. They were a hugely problematic resource drain, and the game should run smoother now that they're no longer such an issue
[*] Fixed oversight where certain lamps would display shadows
[/list]

[b]Enemy Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] The time that enemies are stunned after being shot is now dependent on difficulty
[*] Fixed bug where some enemies would fly into the air when the game was at 120 FPS. That was a strange one
[*] Fixed bug where Melee Outlaws had a hard time hitting the player
[*] Fixed a bug where Melee Outlaws would try to hit the player from an unreasonably long range
[*] Increased damage of Cult Shotgunner
[*] Reworked how enemies notice the player
[/list]

[b]️Level Design Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added lots of invisible walls to help prevent player going out-of-bounds
[*] Improved placement of various objects
[*] Added more enemies to Level 4, 7, and 8
[/list]

[b]Misc. Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where Level 2 Hunt was not playable
[*] Fixed bug where Level 3 Hunt and Level 3 Holdout had the same level ID. You now can earn full stars for the holdout mission like you're meant to
[*] Improved how mission images look
[*] Set default Rendering Scale to 1.0x instead of Dynamic
[*] Added mission type name below level name in mission select UI
[*] Improved Level 5 (Boulder Bluff) description a bit
[*] Removed ability to change to 2D environmental objects. This settings didn't have a noticeable affect on performance, and the new LOD system works differently than before, meaning this setting would need to be re-implemented
[/list]

notes.title: Update 6 — Bug Fixes, Balance Tweaks
notes.content:
A huge thank-you to to everyone who's been reporting bugs, it's been a massive help! As much as I enjoy working on the game, repeatedly playtesting gets pretty exhausting, so your feedback goes a long way in helping me track down and squash issues.

If you spot any bugs, feel free to share them on the Steam Discussions page, the Discord server, or even in a review -- whatever's easiest for you.

[b]️ Balance Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] Set a max speed for enemy bullets for better consistency
[*] Set a max fire rate for enemies so they don't rapid fire on high difficulties
[*] Made sprint no longer use energy (bullet time) resource
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where enemies would fall through the floor sometimes
[*] Fixed bug where enemies would shoot through walls
[*] Fixed bug where melee enemies would magically smack you from afar
[*] Fixed bug which sometimes made picking up items unreliable
[*] Fixed bug where weapons weren't showing up properly in Level 1
[*] Fixed bug with Triple Tapper firing between guns during a burst when dual wielded
[*] Fixed bug where you could trigger a checkpoint in Level 7 twice
[*] Fixed bug where exploding barrels in level 6 wouldn't reset properly on death
[*] Fixed bug where newly dropped objects persisted after loading a checkpoint
[*] Fixed mistake on stats of Bolt Thrower, Blunderbuss, and Triple Tapper
[*] Rewrote code to handle bullet time state to make it more robust
[*] Improved quality of enemy bullet hit detection
[/list]

notes.title: Game Released — Planned Post-Launch Updates
notes.content:
The game is now released and available for purchase! If you want to support the game, leaving a Steam review would help greatly. Games on Steam get a boost in visibility after 10 reviews, so it would be great to hit that number specifically.

[b]Launch Content Highlights[/b]
[list]
[*] 9 Main Missions
[*] 7 Side Missions
[*] 16 Weapons: 7 Rifles, 4 Shotguns, 5 Sidearms
[*] 2 Bosses
[*] 21 Achievements
[/list]

[b]Here’s the stuff I’ve got planned for future updates[/b]

[/list]

[*] 11 new Side Missions
[/list]

[b]️ New Features[/b]
[list]

[*] Full Controller Support
[*] Official Steam Deck Support
[/list]

[b]Reworks[/b]
[list]
[*] Skills menu overhaul
[*] End‑of‑mission menu redesign
[*] Equipped weapon display revamp
[/list]

[b]Improvements & Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] General bug fixes and balance tweaks
[*] Level design improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Update 5 — Balance Changes
notes.content:
This update is all about encouraging more thoughtful use of bullet time, plus a handful of balance tweaks across weapons, movement, and AI. I’ve been focused on performance and balance recently, but I’m shifting back to content creation. Updates will be slowing down as I gear up for the full launch.

[b]Accuracy & ADS[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased player accuracy when aiming down sights.
[*] Slowed movement significantly while ADS with rifles and shotguns.
[*] Sidearm ADS does not affects movement speed.
[*] Removed a previously extra dual-wield accuracy penalty when aiming with sidearms.
[/list]

[b]Bullet Time & Energy[/b]
Note: Energy is used for both bullet time and dashing/sprinting
[list]
[*] Energy now recharges more slowly after exiting bullet time.
[*] Energy drains at a reduced rate while in bullet time.
[*] Shots fired at distant enemies consume more bullet-time energy than close-range hits.
[*] Enemies keep their normal reaction speed in bullet time (their bullets still move slower).
[*] Killing nearby enemies will recharge more energy than killing far away enemies.
[/list]

[b]Weapon & Ammo Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased overall damage of sidearms slightly.
[*] Slightly reduced backup ammo capacity for all weapons.
[*] Boosted the rate of fire on the Ranger Repeater.
[/list]

[b]Enemy Behavior[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies now use suppressive fire, targeting your last known position to pin you down.
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an “Exit Level” button to the weapon-select screen at level start.
[*] Weapon reticle now flares when you swap to a new weapon.
[*] New in-game tips added.
[*] Sound cue plays when you run out of bullet time while aiming.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the top bar of the pause menu showing in the settings sub-menu.
[*] Made enemy bullets consistently disappear when the shooter dies.
[*] Fixed a bug allowing sprinting while ADS.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 4 — Graphics Settings
notes.content:
This update brings new graphics options to help better tune performance. I’ve added granular controls for rendering quality and visuals to help troubleshoot slowdowns, plus a couple of minor tweaks and fixes. If you're noticing problems with performance, let me know, I’m still working on optimization. 

[b]Graphics Settings[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Rendering Scale:[/b] Adjust overall render resolution for smoother framerates.
[*] [b]Environmental Object Detail:[/b]  Toggle level-of-detail on world geometry.
[*] [b]V-Sync:[/b] Enable or disable vertical sync to manage screen tearing.
[*] [b]Environment Outlines:[/b] Show or hide object outlines for style vs. performance.
[*] [b]SSAO (Screen-Space Ambient Occlusion):[/b] Show or hide shadowing in crevices.
[*] [b]Tonemap:[/b] Control post-process color grading for contrast and brightness.
[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous Graphics[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Disable Border Texture[/b]: Turn off decorative edges.
[/list]

[b]Controls Update[/b]

[list]
[*] Escape key now closes menus on the level-select screen.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed 3D weapon model compression when swapping to a new weapon after dying.
[*] Fixed high contrast and saturation after shader compilation (common on Level 1).
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]

[list]
[*] Frame rates other than 60 FPS affect player hand animation speed.
[*] Dash energy drain scales with frame rate; lower FPS drains more energy.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 3 — Blunderbuss Shotgun
notes.content:
This update focuses on refining core systems and visuals, while adding new weapons and levels—most of which are exclusive to the full game. The main focus was on improving shooting mechanics, balancing weapons, and making pickups and effects less jarring. The new Blunderbuss shotgun is available in the demo, and several other weapons are added for the full game. Overall, things are mostly on track for a July release.

[b]New Weapons[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Blunderbuss[/b] (Demo): A powerful single-shot shotgun.
[*] [b]Bolt Thrower[/b] (Full Game): A crossbow, the first projectile weapon in Saloonery.
[*] [b]Galting Gun[/b] (Full Game): Fires super fast with no reload needed.
[*] [b]Hellfire Shotgun[/b] (Full Game): High rate of fire and large ammo capacity shotgun.
[/list]

[b]Weapon System Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] “Primary” and “Secondary” weapon categories renamed to [b]Rifle[/b] and [b]Shotgun[/b] to better define roles.
[*] Rifle and Shotgun weapons now use distinct ammo types: [b]Rifle Ammo[/b] and [b]Shotgun Ammo[/b].
[*] Rapid Repeater switched to Rifle type instead of Secondary.
[*] General weapon rebalance based on improved shooting input handling.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay & Controls[/b]

[list]
[*] Shooting input reworked for better consistency and less awkwardness.
[*] Removed attack delay as a weapon attribute due to bugs.
[*] Consistency of fire rate improved when entering/exiting bullet time.
[*] Falling off the map no longer kills instantly; instead resets player with damage (except on High Noon difficulty).
[/list]

[b]Visual & Audio Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] White flash effects switched to vignette style for less jarring feedback.
[*] Decreased white flash effect on enemy kills.
[*] Improved red damage gradient for clearer hit feedback.
[*] Reloading sounds added, specific to each weapon.
[*] Pickup icons replaced with glowing highlights for better visibility.
[*] Increased visibility of chests and barrels in the environment.
[*] Updated intro animation when the game starts.
[/list]

[b]Level & Pickup Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Randomly placed chests replaced with manually placed ones for consistent pickup locations and less redundancy.
[*] Added Shotgun Ammo pickups to all existing levels.
[*] Minor refinements to level design on some maps.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes & Performance[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed enemy shaking bug when they first appear.
[*] Slight performance improvements for smoother gameplay.
[*] Removed sprint sideway slow-down and toned down speed-up effect for less disorientation.
[/list]

[b]Settings[/b]

[list]
[*] Added option to [b]Disable Crosshair[/b] in settings.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
This update improves the Settings menu and fixes bugs.

I'm working on fixing additional bugs in coming updates. If you have any bugs to report, the Discussions section of the Steam Community page would be a helpful place to put them.

[b]General Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed bug with checkpoints activating out of order.
[*] Made running out of ammo with the pistol while aiming look less awkward.
[*] Reworked code around taking damage to make bugs with saturation and contrast less likely.
[*] Animated tutorial text popup.
[*] Fixed some bugs with weapon animations when at low FPS.
[*] Improve reticle flare animation.
[*] Reorganized Settings menu.
[*] Added autoswap feature which automatically switches to newly picked up weapons. Togglable in the Settings menu, on by default.
[*] Added Interact as a bindable key in the Settings menu (was previously always E).
[*] Added ADS toggle to Settings menu.
[*] Added tooltips to Settings menu.
[*] Added crouch toggle option to Settings menu.
[*] Increased size of reticle hit marker slightly.
[*] Fixed bug where game UI was left aligned on wide monitor screens, now just has black borders.
[*] Fixed typo in skills menu.
[*] Centered weapon swap interface slightly better.
[*] Fixed bug which made projectiles hard to see when first fired.
[*] Fixed bug which caused Skill Stars to be counted incorrectly.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
This update fixes bugs and improves the first-time player experience. It also includes several minor map improvements and misc. changes.

I'm working on fixing additional bugs in coming updates. If you have any bugs to report, the Discussions section of the community would be a helpful place to put them.

[b]General Changes[/b]

[list]
[*]Updated to Godot version 4.4.1
[*]Added ability to invert aiming y-axis from the settings menu.
[*]Added blur behind settings menu when opened from the main menu.
[*]Added flashing highlight to unplayed missions.
[*]Made dark barrels less red in color so they don't look like they would explode. Actual exploding red barrels likely coming in the future.
[*]Added flashing arrow when no level played yet to highlight Level 1.
[*]Changed the player to stop reloading while aiming unless their equipped weapon is completely out of ammo.
[*]Improved the layout of levels 2 and 3 to make them easier to navigate.
[*]Reduced intensity of rain in Level 3 to not mess up YT compression as much.
[*]Improved headshot tip wording.
[*]Added some missed shaders to shader compiling.
[*]Fixed incorrect description of Harmonica Pistol.
[*]Fix enemy on cliff in Level 3 shooting at player prematurely.
[*]Fix bug where health icon remains after health bottle has been picked up.
[*]Fix grammar error in lvl_2_holdout description.
[*]Fix location in lvl_3 where enemies could become stuck in the ground.
[*]Fix places in lvl_3 where player jittered when moving.
[*]Fixed bug causing stars to not be unlocked correctly.
[/list]

[b]Demo Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved end-of-demo message
[/list]

[b]Full Game Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed "Wishlist" button
[/list]
